label: Future recording-layer window (soft, ≥10 S/m)
note: Team-chosen bounds for discussion, not a literature value: roughly brain-like stiffness (0.1-100 kPa) with conductivity of at least 10 S/m. This only matters for a future version of the wells with electrodes; the first experiment uses a clear, non-conductive, degradable gel. The lower bound sits above what saline (~1.5 S/m) and brain tissue (~0.1-1 S/m) conduct through ions alone. Edit this file to change the shaded region.
